modmenu.summaryTranslation.dopes_seamles: Takes a screenshot when you leave a world or server and shows it again when you rejoin.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.dopes_sea: Takes a screenshot of the game when you leave a world or server, and displays it on the loading screen when you rejoin it. With slideshow backgrounds, chunk counter and smooth fade animations.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.config.gen: Enable or disable the entire mod.
Show a slideshow instead of a static background when the world has no screenshot yet.
Wait for all chunks to fully load before starting the fade animation.
Show chunk loading progress at the top of the screen (loaded / total).

Take and show screenshots while playing on servers. When disabled, no screenshots are taken or shown for servers; the loading screen falls back to the slideshow (if enabled). The chunk counter keeps working.

Show the screenshot (or slideshow) over the transition when entering a world or server and when leaving them. The screen fades in, starts the load and stays on top until the loading screen appears (hiding the screens in between), then fades out. Its blur and dim are the same as on the loading screen, but static.
How long the auxiliary screen takes to appear and to disappear. The same for entering and leaving, before and after the world. 0 = no animation.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.config.dis: How strongly the screenshot is blurred while the loading screen is up. 0 = no blur, higher = stronger (max 64). The blur is built in steps, so the animation looks smooth.
Percentage of darkening over the background image. 0 = no dim. It is always fully applied, it does not fade in.
How long the screenshot takes to fade out once the world is ready: the image disappears and the world shows through. 0 = instant.

How much of the fade animation the blur takes to disappear. 100% = the blur is gone exactly when the fade ends, 50% = twice as fast, 0% = no animation (the blur stays until the end of the fade). The slideshow never animates its blur: the blur stays until the end of the fade.
Resolution the screenshot is rendered at on the loading screen: 100% = as is, 50% = half. The image is always stretched over the whole screen, a lower value only reduces quality and memory usage.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.config.tim: Keep the loading screen visible for at least this long so the screenshot can be seen. 0 = disabled.
Never keep the loading screen open longer than this, even if the chunks are still loading. 0 = no limit.
dopes_seamless_loading_screen.config.sli: How often slideshow images change. 0 = slideshow disabled (one random static image). A folder with a single file also disables slide switching.
Duration of the fade transition between slideshow images. 0 = instant switch.
Opens the folder where you can put your own PNG images for the slideshow.
